directive.question: Normalize Teradyne governance/dilution overhang and assemble current debt/convertible exposure sufficiently to close the exact T0 underwriting gate.
directive.whyItMatters: The bootstrap queue marks governance/dilution normalization plus debt/convertible assembly as gating before packet completion and Chief adjudication.
directive.preferredPrimarySource: Teradyne 2025 Form 10-K and latest 2026 Form 10-Q filings with the SEC; 2026 definitive proxy for governance context.
lawfulFallbacks: Teradyne investor-relations copies of the same filings
directive.successCondition: Primary filings establish current shares, plan capacity/dilutive securities, stock-compensation burden, current debt/convertible state and liquidity without double counting legacy convertible/warrant instruments.

claims: 156,555,950 common shares were outstanding as of 2026-02-16.

At 2025-12-31, 3,050,235 shares were available under the 2006 Equity Plan and 3,176,598 securities were available under the ESPP; the equity-compensation table includes 1,634,922 restricted-stock units outside weighted-average exercise-price calculation.
Unrecognized compensation expense related to non-vested RSUs/options was $97.3 million, expected over a weighted-average 2.6 years.
The legacy 1.25% convertible senior notes matured in December 2023; no live convertible principal is presented as current 2025 debt.
156,542,162 common shares were outstanding as of 2026-04-27.
Quarter-end common shares were 156.540 million; Q1 net issuance under stock-based plans was 0.476 million shares and stock-based compensation expense recognized in equity was $20.649 million.
Diluted EPS used 1.226 million dilutive potential common shares: 1.148 million RSUs, 0.074 million options and 0.004 million ESPP shares; less than 0.1 million RSUs were anti-dilutive.

The $750 million senior secured revolver had zero outstanding balance at 2026-03-29 versus $200 million at 2025-12-31; Teradyne was covenant-compliant and stated it intended to extend the facility before its 2026-12-10 expiry.
Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities totaled $394.0 million at 2026-03-29 and management stated these resources plus the revolver were sufficient for at least twelve months.
Teradyne reported $200 million of net revolver repayments during the first half of 2026 and remained covenant-compliant at 2026-06-28.
Management again stated cash, marketable securities and the senior secured revolver were sufficient for at least the next twelve months.
The filing continues to identify only the shareholder-approved ESPP and 2006 Equity Plan as equity-compensation plans and does not identify a new live convertible financing instrument.

evidenceVsInference.evidence: Primary SEC filings directly establish outstanding shares, plan reserves, RSU/options dilution, stock-compensation expense, revolver capacity/balance and liquidity statements.
evidenceVsInference.inference: The old convertible-note/warrant complex should not be carried forward as current dilution: the notes matured in 2023 and associated warrants expired through July 2024. Current 2026 diluted-share disclosures instead identify RSUs, options and ESPP as the live incremental share sources. This is a normalization inference from the filing chronology, not a claim that Teradyne can never issue future convertibles.

contradictions.issue: Legacy filings describe a large convertible-note/warrant dilution complex, while the T0 gate asks for current convertible assembly.
contradictions.disposition: Historical only. The notes matured in December 2023 and warrants expired by July 2024; current 2026 diluted-share tables contain RSUs/options/ESPP rather than convertible/warrant shares. Do not double-count legacy instruments.

gateImpact.reason: The exact capital-structure/debt/convertible blocker has a reconciled primary-source answer. Ordinary packet compilation may now consume this auxiliary evidence; Deep Resolver should not continue looping on this gate.

unknowns: Future equity grants and future financing choices remain uncertain and are non-gating future uncertainty.
The revolver extension terms after the disclosed 2026 intention are not needed to resolve the present historical/current capital-structure gate.
